subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Apple Pay and Contactless Payments
description: A micro-lesson that makes Apple Pay and Contactless Payments usable.

hook.text: Apple Pay turned your phone into a wallet. Now many people leave home without cash or cards.

buildup.text: NFC technology lets phones communicate with payment terminals in milliseconds.

discovery.text: Tokenization means the merchant never sees your real card number, reducing fraud.

twist.text: In some countries, mobile payments surpassed cash. China's Alipay processes $17 trillion yearly.

climax.text: Mobile payments are replacing physical wallets, cash, and even the concept of change.
